name: The Trials [PHASE 0]
desc:
Welcome, Participant! 
Compete against other participants in a lethal facility designed to kill all but one. It's your choice to decide whether or not to participate, but once you do, the choice is no longer yours. The Trials is a thrilling adventure game that requires some wit and skill to succeed. 

I made The Trials (BETA) in 2019 and have decided to bring it back for a full series! The beta was child's play, Phase 1 is only the beginning. Join the group to stay in the loop with updates! 

**WANT TO BECOME A VALID PARTICIPANT?** 
~Join ZELZ to get the Valid Participant name tag! Ranks will have more relevance to the game in the future features~
